title: Mark K NDE 4352
content: I had been shot in the arm and side. It took over six hours to get medical help. I remember lying on the operating table while two doctors were working on me (one was Howard). My arm was held up in the air while they were working on my arm. One of them said, 'There's some buckshot.' The other said, 'I'll get it.' It was then that I realized I was out of my body about ten feet above the table looking down. That freaked me out a little and then my whole life flashed before me. It was like the scales of Justice. I could see the bad things on one side and the good on the other. I could no longer see me on the table, but I was on the bottom of a very beautiful colorful (like fire opal) blue, red, yellow translucent wall. As I floated to the top and looked over, there were five people standing on the bottom of the other side, dressed in white gowns. They were very thin and young, I don't know why but I believed they were relatives and one was my grandmother from my father's side. She died years before I was born. They called me by name and tried to call me over; trying to reassure me, it was all right. I felt it was very peaceful there but I was afraid and went back down. I don't remember anything else until I was in a coma (two weeks). When I woke up, I asked the doctor about the incident and he remembered and said we thought we lost you for a while. I truly know there is a God it's beyond belief.

arrival.other_being_detail: Five people standing on the other side, dressed in white gowns; believed to be relatives, including paternal grandmother (died before he was born).

environment.environment_other_detail: A very beautiful colorful translucent wall ("like fire opal") with blue, red, yellow; he was at the bottom and floated to the top and looked over to the other side.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Translucent colorful wall/partition; five thin young people in white gowns on the other side calling him by name.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above operating table with doctors speaking, then immediate life flash, then found himself at the bottom of a translucent colorful wall and floated upward to see five figures on the other side; he went back down and later was in a coma.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review described as "like the scales of Justice" with bad things on one side and good on the other; boundary described as a translucent colorful wall ("like fire opal").
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was then that I realized I was out of my body about ten feet above the table looking down.” “My whole life flashed before me. It was like the scales of Justice.” “They called me by name and tried to call me over; trying to reassure me, it was all right.” “I truly know there is a God it's beyond belief.”
